profile.local_funs: Native local-fun layouts and module-local lambda entries, module leases, environment GC/copy/equality, whole make_fun3/call_fun2 generators and native construction/call dispatch. Captured, nested and closed guest closures execute on the worker. Lambda targets/arity/indexes are verified before emission; literal operand sites retain defining code before instruction effects. Other valid MFAs/apply shapes return infrastructure REFUSED; malformed atoms/proper-list inputs retain native badarg. Heavy BIF epilogues propagate infrastructure REFUSED/ENVIRONMENT separately from guest errors. External/unloaded fun effects, preloaded spawn/1 wrappers, monitors, signals and mailboxes remain unadmitted.

profile.message_storage: Native message-reference prefix, self-contained heap-fragment/offheap storage and inner-queue pointer cursors; independent embedded-fun module leases and namespace roots; prepare before enqueue, exact allocation-prefix rollback, selective cursor/tail removal and process-destructor draining. Whole native send dispatch now executes the positive local-internal-PID branch using prepared owned fragments, namespace-relative lookup, real sender identity and tail publication. Dead local PIDs drop the message and return it; invalid destination terms yield badarg; names/external destinations refuse the runtime profile. Infrastructure OOM/LIMIT/REFUSED remain separate, and completed sends yield at the successor without replay. Terminal exit/destruction drains queued fragments. Native move_trim_yxt and move2_par_xxxy fusions retain their whole cases after original move/trim dataflow verification. Actor-heap message import now prepares heap capacity and embedded-fun leases, copies through a temporary offheap chain, and publishes only after exact copy completion; failure clears temporary references and new code-lease prefixes. Tests destroy the immutable source, collect the importing actor and execute the copied closure from an independent child. Guest receive, other signals, monitors and timers remain unadmitted.
profile.engine: Owned shared native catalog and allocation substrate; C worlds and tasks retain Engine through physical retirement; worker-side orphan/space retirement and host lifetime checks share the mutex; final join follows host unlock
profile.host_protocol: C world/call/reclamation ownership and thin C++ adapter; copied binary input/output, reserved capacity, once-only completion and physical selected-world retirement; the host protocol itself adds no opcode or BIF capabilities
